headline: VIZSLA COPPER MAKES HG PROSPECT DISCOVERY — 60+ Cumulative Metres Semi-Massive Sulphide Hit; Zone 1 High-Grade Core Confirmed At Palmer VMS
snippet: Vizsla Copper Corp. (TSX-V: VCU) announced August 31 that drilling at the HG Prospect — located west of the Palmer Deposit in Southeast Alaska — has confirmed new copper-zinc-silver mineralization over more than 600 metres of strike length, constituting a new discovery. Drill hole CMR26-211 at the AG Deposit returned an interval from 140.2 to 248.2 metres containing more than 60 cumulative metres of semi-massive, massive, and barite-bearing massive sulphide mineralization, while two additional holes confirmed Zone 1's high-grade core. Palmer is a volcanogenic massive sulphide (VMS) system with geological similarities to the historic Greens Creek mine — one of the world's highest-grade silver-zinc-gold-lead VMS deposits. For retail investors: a Zone 1 high-grade confirmation combined with a brand-new discovery at HG on the same programme represents a meaningful step toward growing Palmer's footprint — VMS deposits are valued on strike length and depth extent, and Vizsla has now demonstrated both dimensions in a single update.

headline: PERU CLEARS CONDOR RESOURCES FOR 40-PAD PUCAMAYO SUR DRILL — Up To 6,000m Epithermal Gold-Silver Program Now Fully Permitted
snippet: Condor Resources Inc. (TSX-V: CN) announced August 31 that Peru's Ministry of Energy and Mines approved the Declaración de Impacto Ambiental (DIA) for the Pucamayo Sur target area at the company's flagship Pucamayo gold-silver project. The DIA authorises 40 drill pads with multiple holes per pad and a five-year term; Condor has planned an exploration program of up to 6,000 metres at Pucamayo Sur in phases. The 85-square-kilometre property sits in Peru's Tertiary volcanic belt — the same belt hosting several major epithermal gold deposits — approximately 185 kilometres southeast of Lima at elevations of 3,800–4,200 metres. Commencement now depends on receipt of an Initiation of Activities permit and financing. For retail investors: the Ministry of Energy and Mines approving a 40-pad DIA is a substantial permitting milestone, removing the primary regulatory barrier to first drilling and eliminating years of project-by-project approval risk — a clean permitting status has direct read-through to the project's de-risked value at current gold prices.

headline: PRINCE SILVER COMPLETES 10,000m AT NEVADA HISTORIC MINE — 1,511 g/t Ag Hit And 280 g/t Ag Over 6m In Block Ahead Of Maiden MRE
snippet: Prince Silver Corp. (CSE: PRNC; OTCQX: PRNCF) announced completion of more than 10,000 metres of drilling at its flagship Prince Silver Project in the historic Pioche Mining District, Lincoln County, Nevada — advancing geological modeling toward a maiden mineral resource estimate targeted for early 2027. The 10,000m milestone drilled includes intercepts of 280.75 g/t silver, 0.68 g/t gold, 13.38% manganese, 2.35% lead, and 2.96% zinc over 6.10 metres, as well as a 1,511 g/t silver hit that confirmed the project's high-grade potential. The company is targeting a 100 million ounce silver equivalent resource at Pioche, incorporating 130 historical holes and modern drilling. For retail investors: a 1,511 g/t silver surface intercept in Nevada at a project with 130 historical holes and an established district infrastructure profile is a compelling combination — the key near-term catalyst is whether the early-2027 MRE validates the high-grade core or reveals a more dispersed, lower-grade bulk-tonnage geometry.

headline: V TEN METALS COLLARS INAUGURAL DRILL HOLE AT TANAMI — TSX-V Junior Tests Gold Target In Northern Territory's Premier Mining District
snippet: V Ten Metals Inc. (TSX-V: VTEN) announced August 31 that it has collared the first drill hole of its inaugural diamond drill program at the Tanami Property in Northern Territory, Australia. The Tanami region hosts the Newmont-operated Tanami Gold Mine, one of Australia's most significant gold producers, making it a proven district for large-scale gold systems. V Ten's program represents the company's first drill test of the property's geological targets. For retail investors: this is a first-drill-ever announcement — results will come with assay returns expected in Q4 2026. The geological significance is that first holes in established gold districts that match the mineralizing setting of nearby producers carry meaningfully different risk profiles than greenfield exploration; Tanami's track record of large, low-grade bulk-tonnage systems means the district model is well-understood.

headline: BLOSSOM GOLD LAUNCHES 12,000-FOOT RC PROGRAM ON KAMMA CLAIMS — Adjacent To Rosebud Open Pit; Q4 2026 Assays To Test Western Extension
snippet: Blossom Gold Inc. (TSX: BGAU) announced August 31 the commencement of a 12,000-foot reverse circulation (RC) drilling program on its Kamma Claims, situated west of the company's Rosebud open-pit heap leach gold project. The Kamma program targets geological extensions of the Rosebud mineralizing system, with assay results expected in Q4 2026. For retail investors: RC drilling immediately adjacent to a heap leach operation is a capital-efficient approach to resource expansion — the processing infrastructure is in place at Rosebud, and any significant discovery in the Kamma Claims would add directly to the project's economic envelope without new infrastructure cost. Q4 2026 assay results represent a concrete near-term catalyst with a defined timeline.

headline: SPECS HELD RECORD GOLD LONGS INTO WARSH SHOCK — COT Positioning Data Reveals Maximum Crowding Risk Ahead Of August 31 Selloff
snippet: GoldSeek's Commitments of Traders analysis for the week ending August 28, 2026 captures speculative positioning in COMEX gold and silver immediately before Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole address and the US-Iran escalation that drove gold down more than $160 on August 31. Large speculators held near-maximum net long positions going into the week — a crowded structure that amplifies downside during macro shocks as leveraged longs are forced to liquidate at the same time. Silver speculative positioning also showed elevated exposure ahead of the repricing. For retail investors: the COT report is a short-term contrarian indicator, not a trend signal — historically, forced liquidation of maximum speculative gold longs during a macro shock (such as a surprise Fed hike signal) marks the beginning of a new accumulation phase at lower prices rather than a fundamental trend change, particularly when the underlying drivers of the multi-year bull market — central bank demand, dollar debasement, geopolitical tension — remain in place.

headline: GDX AIMED AT ALL-TIME HIGHS BY YEAR-END? — Analysis Says Corrective Drift Is Ending After August's Record +43% Month
snippet: A GoldSeek technical and fundamental analysis argues that GDX's corrective drift following its August 2026 all-time highs is reaching an inflection point, with a blast to new highs by year-end possible if gold moves above current resistance. The analysis highlights that GDX's top 25 miners now trade at just 16.5x trailing earnings — a multi-decade valuation low by historical standards — at a time when the sector is generating record AISC margins and free cash flow. The bearish caveat: September-October are historically gold's most volatile months, and the September FOMC (currently 62% priced for a 25bp hike) creates near-term headwinds. For retail investors: 16.5x trailing earnings while the sector generates record free cash flow represents the definition of a valuation anomaly — the argument for gold equities is not that they will follow gold tick-for-tick, but that when the market re-rates the sector on fundamentals rather than sentiment, the catch-up potential is asymmetric to the upside.

headline: LITHIUM MINERS AUGUST 2026: BALD HILL AND FINNISS RESTARTS PRESSURE $158,500 CNY/T Recovery — Full Monthly Intelligence Roundup
snippet: Seeking Alpha's comprehensive monthly lithium miners roundup for August 2026 covers the sector through a pivotal month: lithium carbonate climbed 13.21% to 158,500 CNY per tonne (+99% year-over-year), while the market simultaneously absorbed restart signals from Mineral Resources' Bald Hill (165,000 dmt/yr capacity ramping from July) and Core Lithium's Finniss project resumption. The report surveys developments across TSX-V, ASX, and NASDAQ lithium producers and explorers — drill results, resource updates, project financing, and producer guidance. For retail investors: the August monthly is published at a critical inflection point — the tug-of-war between Chinese EV demand absorbing restart volumes versus 2027 oversupply projections from new mine sanctions in Argentina, Chile, and the DRC will define Q4 lithium equity performance. Projects with sub-$700/t AISC and large proven resource bases are best positioned to navigate restart-driven volatility.

headline: GOLD AND SILVER MINERS: THE LOW-HANGING FRUIT 15 STOCKS TRADING AT SUB-16x Earnings With Record FCF Margins
snippet: A Seeking Alpha analyst identifies 15 gold and silver mining stocks as prime speculative opportunities, arguing the sector is deeply undervalued at sub-16x earnings while generating record free cash flow at $4,300+ gold and $65+ silver. The analysis is anchored by an aggressive thesis projecting $7,000 gold and $200 silver within 2-3 years, focusing on junior and mid-tier producers with maximum operational leverage to continued precious metals price appreciation — stocks where a 50% gold price increase translates into a 150–300% earnings increase due to fixed cost structures. For retail investors: this analysis requires scrutiny of the author's $7,000 gold assumption — however, the core observation that gold and silver mining equities remain historically undervalued relative to underlying metals at current prices is well-supported by sector earnings data. The August 31 gold selloff on the Warsh/Iran shock may create exactly the entry points this thesis describes.

headline: WHY SILVER IS RISING AND WHY IT WON'T STOP — China Strategic Reclassification, Sixth Deficit, And The Industrial Demand Floor — Money Metals
snippet: Money Metals Exchange's analysis of silver's 2026 structural drivers argues that silver's outperformance of gold on shock-events — including today's +1% silver vs. -3% gold divergence on the Warsh/Iran selloff — reflects a fundamental regime change in silver's demand base. Three structural pillars: China's January 1, 2026 reclassification of silver as a strategic material requiring government export licences (only 44 authorized firms), the World Silver Survey 2026 projection of a sixth consecutive annual supply deficit at 46.3 million ounces, and growing industrial demand from solar panels, EVs, AI data center cooling systems, and semiconductor fabrication. For retail investors: when silver outperforms gold during a monetary selloff, it signals that industrial buyers are absorbing selling pressure that would otherwise push prices lower — a demand structure that gold, as a purely monetary metal, doesn't possess. The gold-silver ratio's direction on shock-days is now as informative as the absolute price moves.
